div.div:
Legend
Outer box: the card component
Blue box: button, here an invisible overlay over the card
White box: a row of text or values
Dashed amber box: row drawn only when its prop is given
Rows follow the order of the markup, top to bottom

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
